<action type="say">
If it’s normally visible under this login at the same bank, but it’s not appearing in the system list I can access, that usually means there’s a temporary visibility or access issue on the bank’s side, not with your account itself.

A couple of quick things you can try right now:
- Log out of online banking and sign back in, then check if the checking account reappears.
- If you’re on the app, try the website (or vice versa) and refresh the accounts view.

If it’s still missing, you’ll need a bank representative to fix the linkage. When you contact support (phone or secure message in the app), you can say:

“My checking account is normally visible under this login, but it suddenly isn’t showing in online banking or in the accounts list used by virtual assistant tools. Please check that the account is active and correctly linked to my online banking profile, and restore its visibility.”

Once they correct that, your checking account will appear in the account list, and I’ll be able to pull and show your balance.</action>
